text: Freedom may be mankind’s natural state, but so is sitting in a tree eating your dinner while it is still wriggling.
author: Terry Pratchett
visual_brief: A precise architectural section drawing in white on black, showing a stark, cantilevered modernist steel terrace projecting over open space, terminating abruptly into a single rough, unpeeled tree bough. Fine dimension strings, plumb lines, and load vector arrows annotate the junction where engineered geometry meets raw wood.
alt: White-line architectural section of a cantilevered steel beam transitioning into a rough tree bough
